exchanges: hiya, finally home. long day
Welcome back. Anything in particular make it long?
just work stuff. Mei got in before me which never happens, she's a teacher at Fairfield Primary and she said the kids were feral today
Ha, sounds like a full-moon kind of day. Hopefully she's recovering with a cup of tea.
she's on the sofa with a glass of wine actually lol
Even better, honestly.
the landlord's coming tomorrow to look at the shower
Is it the pressure or the temperature that's playing up?
both lol. mr thorsen says he'll 'take a look' which means it'll take weeks
Ha, the classic landlord look. Maybe photos would speed things up.
good shout ill send some
A paper trail never hurts.
oh wait, Mei just corrected me, she moved schools in january, she's at Elmwood Primary now, not Fairfield. I keep forgetting
Easy to forget a change like that. Is the new school closer?
yeah she walks there now
That's a nice perk, no commute stress.
mrs o'sullivan from next door brought round a cake for no reason
That's lovely. Neighbours like that are rare.
she does it like once a month, she says she bakes too much since her husband passed
That's sweet and a bit sad. It sounds like she enjoys having people to share with.
yeah we always say thanks and chat. she talks about her son a lot
She must be proud of him.
very, he's a firefighter up in Manchester and she's got photos of him in his gear all over her fridge
That's a proud mum move. Must be a worry too, with work like that.
she says she prays every night lol
Understandable, really.
darius is cooking tonight, its his turn
What's on the menu?
some stew his gran taught him, it smells amazing
Family recipes always smell the best.
ibrahim is gonna eat like three bowls, he's in training for a triathlon in july so he's always starving
That makes sense, all that swimming, cycling and running burns a lot. Stew is good fuel.
he swims at 6am before work, madness
That's real dedication. I'd struggle with that alarm.
same lol
Any plans for the weekend?
farmers market saturday maybe
Nice, a good way to spend a morning.
or just the greengrocer on the corner, ibrahim's place. not housemate ibrahim lol, the shop one
Two Ibrahims, I see. Is the shop a good one?
best veg around. he's doing the london marathon in april, he told me while weighing my tomatoes, so we've got two ibrahims both doing races lol
Ha, what a coincidence. They should compare training plans.
i said that and he laughed
Maybe he'll give your housemate some tips.
mei just said the stew is ready
Perfect timing, enjoy it.
omg it's so good
Darius has a gift then.
he really does, ibrahim's on his second bowl already
Ha, as predicted.
mr thorsen replied about the shower btw, says thursday
That's sooner than expected. Good news.
miracles happen
Clearly.
darius just showed us a ukulele he bought off a guy at work, he's going to learn songs off youtube
That could be fun, or very loud. Has he played anything before?
nope never. so its going to be painful for a while
Every beginner goes through the squeaky stage. Maybe set some practice hours.
good idea before he drives us all mad
A little structure will save everyone's sanity.

questions.message: what's the big race my housemate ibrahim has coming up
remind me what mrs o'sullivan's son does
Mei's school is Elmwood these days, yeah?
what did darius pick up from his coworker
honestly i think im going to have a bath and an early night
